subject.title: feat(talk): describe_view inline vision for OpenAI Realtime + Gemini Live

question: Should OpenClaw accept a browser-direct Video Talk `describe_view` feature, and if so must camera permission be scoped to the Control UI route rather than the shared Gateway default?
rationale: This changes browser camera permission and image-data boundaries, so code review cannot safely decide the permanent consent and provider-data policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Scope Control UI Camera Access
options.body: Keep the shared Gateway default at `camera=()`, add a narrow Control UI-only camera permission path, align denial behavior across providers, and require real browser/provider proof before merge.

options.title: Approve Global Same-Origin Camera
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly accept `camera=(self)` on all Gateway responses only after security review confirms that broader same-origin camera capability is intended.

options.title: Pause For Transport Design
options.body: Pause this browser-direct PR if maintainers want the broader provider/gateway video-frame contract settled first at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89131.

recommendation.title: Scope Control UI Camera Access
recommendation.body: Keep the shared Gateway default at `camera=()`, add a narrow Control UI-only camera permission path, align denial behavior across providers, and require real browser/provider proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current assignee and the strongest current-main owner signal for the Talk/UI surfaces touched by this PR.
